company_name.justification: The buyer is identified in the first sentence: "Lancaster Resources Inc. (CSE: LCR) ... is pleased to announce entry into a binding Letter of Intent on July 23, 2023 (the 'Agreement') to acquire 100% of the Trans-Taiga Lithium Project".

ceo_buyer.justification: The press release is signed by "Penny White, President & Chief Executive Officer, Lancaster Resources Inc.".

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Lancaster Resources Inc., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE: LCR), and the detailed quote section specifies a dividend in CAD, implying Canadian Dollars are the transaction currency.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The total cash component is an aggregate of the initial $10,000 cash payment, three anniversary payments of $26,000 each, a $50,000 milestone payment, and a $1,000,000 milestone payment. Text states: '$10,000 in cash', '$26,000 due on the first anniversary date', '$26,000 due on the second anniversary date', '$26,000 due on the third anniversary date', '$50,000 fee if exploration results yield...', and '$1,000,000 if Lancaster publishes a 43-101 technical report...'.
